places.name: Spree
facts: The Spree is a river in Germany and the Czech Republic.
With a length of approximately 400 kilometres, it is the main tributary of the Havel River.

reasons: Asked 3× in UPPCS Mains, UPPCS Prelims (1999, 2002, 2015)

places.name: Tiber
facts: Major river in central Italy.

reasons: Asked 3× in UP Lower Sub. Prelims, UPPCS Prelims (1999, 2002, 2009)

places.name: Elbe
facts: The Elbe is one of the major rivers of Central Europe.
It rises in the Giant Mountains of the northern Czech Republic before traversing much of Bohemia, then Germany before flowing into the North Sea at Cuxhaven, 110 kilometres northwest of Hamburg.

reasons: Asked 2× in UP Lower Sub. Prelims, UPPCS Mains (2004, 2015)

places.name: Potomac
facts: The Potomac River is in the Mid-Atlantic region of the United States and flows from the Potomac Highlands in West Virginia to the Chesapeake Bay in Maryland.

reasons: Asked 2× in UP Lower Sub. Prelims, UPPCS Mains (2003, 2009)

places.name: Missouri
facts: The Missouri River is a river in the Central and Mountain West regions of the United States.

reasons: Asked 2× in UPPCS Mains, UPPCS Prelims (2015, 2025)

places.name: Paraguay River
facts: The Paraguay River is a major river in south-central South America, running through Brazil and Paraguay and forming parts of the Paraguay-Argentina, Brazil-Bolivia, and Brazil-Paraguay borders.

reasons: Asked 2× in UP BEO Prelims, UP RO/ARO Prelims (2016, 2019)

places.name: Hudson River
facts: The Hudson River is a 315-mile river that flows from north to south largely through eastern New York state.

places.name: Salween
facts: The Salween is a Southeast Asian river, about 3,289 km long, flowing from the Tibetan Plateau south into the Andaman Sea.

places.name: Syr Darya
facts: The Syr Darya, historically known as the Jaxartes, is a river in Central Asia.

places.name: Angara
facts: The Angara or Angar is a major river in Siberia, which traces a course through Russia’s Irkutsk Oblast and Krasnoyarsk Krai.

places.name: Dnieper
facts: The Dnieper or Dnepr, also known as the Dnipro, is one of the major transboundary rivers of Europe, rising in the Valdai Hills near Smolensk, Russia, before flowing through Belarus and Ukraine to the Black Sea.

places.name: Po
facts: The Po is the longest river in Italy.
It flows eastward across northern Italy, starting from the Cottian Alps.

places.name: Rhône
facts: The Rhône is a major river in France and Switzerland, rising in the Alps and flowing west and south through Lake Geneva and Southeastern France before discharging into the Mediterranean Sea.

places.name: Don
facts: The Don is the fifth-longest river in Europe.
Flowing from Central Russia to the Sea of Azov in Southern Russia, it is one of Russia’s largest rivers and played an important role for traders from the Byzantine Empire.

places.name: Vistula
facts: The Vistula is the longest river in Poland and the longest river draining into the Baltic Sea, at 1,047 kilometres in length.

reasons: Asked 1× in UP Lower Sub. Prelims (2009)

places.name: Shatt al-Arab
facts: The Shatt al-Arab is a river about 200 kilometres in length that is formed at the confluence of the Euphrates and Tigris rivers in the town of al-Qurnah in the Basra Governorate of southern Iraq.

places.name: Chao Phraya
facts: The Chao Phraya River is the major river in Thailand, with its low alluvial plain forming the centre of the country.

places.name: Columbia River
facts: The Columbia River is the largest river in the Pacific Northwest region of North America.
The river forms in the Rocky Mountains of British Columbia, Canada.

places.name: Irrawaddy
facts: The Irrawaddy River is the principal river of Myanmar, running through the centre of the country.
Myanmar’s most important commercial waterway, it is about 1,350 mi long.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

reasons: Important but asked only once in the collected papers

places.name: Mahaweli
facts: The Mahaweli River, is a 335-kilometre-long river, ranking as the longest river in Sri Lanka.
It has a drainage basin of 10,448 km2, the largest in the country, which covers almost one-fifth of the total area of the island.

places.name: Lake Michigan
facts: Lake Michigan is one of the five Great Lakes of North America.
It is the second-largest of the Great Lakes by volume and depth after Lake Superior and the third-largest by surface area, after Lake Superior and Lake Huron.

reasons: Asked 4× in UPPCS Mains, UPPCS Prelims (1991, 2011, 2015, 2017)

places.name: Lake Huron
facts: Lake Huron is one of the five Great Lakes of North America.
It is shared on the north and east by the Canadian province of Ontario and on the south and west by the U.S. state of Michigan.

reasons: Asked 4× in UPPCS Mains, UPPCS Prelims (1991, 2015, 2017)

places.name: Lake Erie
facts: Lake Erie is the fourth-largest lake by surface area of the five Great Lakes in North America and the eleventh-largest globally.

reasons: Asked 3× in UPPCS Mains, UPPCS Prelims (2011, 2015, 2017)

places.name: Lake Ontario
facts: Lake Ontario is one of the five Great Lakes of North America.
It is bounded on the north, west, and southwest by the Canadian province of Ontario, and on the south and east by the U.S. state of New York.

places.name: Great Bear Lake
facts: Great Bear Lake in the boreal forest of Canada is the largest lake entirely in Canada, the fourth-largest in North America, and the eighth-largest in the world.

reasons: Asked 3× in UP RO/ARO Mains, UPPCS Prelims (2014, 2015, 2016)

places.name: Great Slave Lake
facts: Great Slave Lake is the second-largest lake in the Northwest Territories, Canada, the deepest lake in North America at 614 m, and the tenth-largest lake in the world by area.

places.name: Lake Winnipeg
facts: Lake Winnipeg is a 24,514-square-kilometre lake in North America, in the Canadian province of Manitoba.
Its southern end is about 55 kilometres north of the namesake city, Winnipeg.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

reasons: Asked 2× in UPPCS Prelims, UPSC CSE Prelims (2009, 2015)

places.name: Lake Athabasca
facts: Lake Athabasca is in the north-west corner of Saskatchewan and the north-east corner of Alberta between 58° and 60° N in Canada.

places.name: Reindeer Lake
facts: Reindeer Lake is a large lake in Western Canada located on the border between north-eastern Saskatchewan and north-western Manitoba.

places.name: Lake Tana
facts: Lake Tana is the largest lake in Ethiopia and a source of the Blue Nile.

places.name: Lake Edward
facts: Lake Edward is one of the smaller African Great Lakes.

places.name: Lake Albert
facts: Lake Albert, originally known as Lake Mwitanzige by the Banyoro, Nam Ovoyo Bonyo by the Alur, and temporarily as Lake Mobutu Sese Seko, is a lake located in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

places.name: Lake Van
facts: Lake Van is the largest lake in Turkey.
It lies in the Eastern Anatolia region of Turkey in the provinces of Van and Bitlis, in the Armenian highlands.

places.name: Lake Urmia
facts: Lake Urmia is an endorheic salt lake in Iran.
The lake is located in the Iranian region of Azerbaijan, near the Armenian border and south of the Caspian Sea.

places.name: Tonlé Sap
facts: Tonle Sap is a lake in central Cambodia.
Belonging to the Mekong river system, Tonle Sap is the largest freshwater lake in Southeast Asia and one of the most diverse and productive ecosystems in the world.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: Patos Lagoon
facts: Lagoa dos Patos is a coastal lagoon located in the state of Rio Grande do Sul, southern Brazil.
It covers an area of 10,100 km2, is 290 kilometres long and has a maximum width of 71 kilometres.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: Adriatic Sea
facts: The Adriatic Sea is a body of water separating the Italian Peninsula from the Balkan Peninsula.
The Adriatic is the northernmost arm of the Mediterranean Sea, extending from the Strait of Otranto to the northwest and the Po Valley.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: Aegean Sea
facts: The Aegean Sea is an elongated embayment of the Mediterranean Sea between Europe and Asia.
It is located between the Balkans and Anatolia, and covers an area of some 215,000 km2.

places.name: Ligurian Sea
facts: The Ligurian Sea is an arm of the Mediterranean Sea.
The sea is thought to have been named after the ancient Ligures people.

places.name: Tyrrhenian Sea
facts: The Tyrrhenian Sea is part of the Mediterranean Sea off the western coast of Italy.
Its namesake is from the Tyrrhenian people, identified with the Etruscans of Italy.

places.name: Bering Sea
facts: The Bering Sea is a marginal sea of the Northern Pacific Ocean.
It forms, along with the Bering Strait, the divide between the two largest landmasses on Earth: Eurasia and the Americas.

places.name: Sea of Japan
facts: The Sea of Japan is the marginal sea between the Japanese archipelago, Sakhalin, the Korean Peninsula, and the mainland of the Russian Far East.

places.name: Sea of Azov
facts: The Sea of Azov is an inland shelf sea in Eastern Europe connected to the Black Sea by the narrow Strait of Kerch, and sometimes regarded as a northern extension of the Black Sea.

places.name: Sea of Marmara
facts: The Sea of Marmara, also known as the Sea of Marmora, the Marmara Sea, or Propontis, is a small inland sea entirely within the borders of Turkey.

places.name: East China Sea
facts: The East China Sea is a marginal sea of the Western Pacific Ocean, located directly offshore from East China.

reasons: Asked 1× in UP Lower Sub. Prelims (2009)

places.name: Tasman Sea
facts: The Tasman Sea is a marginal sea of the South Pacific Ocean, situated between Australia and New Zealand.
It measures about 2,000 km across and about 2,800 km from north to south.

places.name: Irish Sea
facts: The Irish Sea is a 46,007 km2 body of water that separates the islands of Ireland and Great Britain.
It is linked to the Celtic Sea in the south by St George’s Channel and to the Inner Seas off the West Coast of Scotland in the north by the North Channel.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: Arctic Ocean
facts: The Arctic Ocean is the smallest and shallowest of the world’s five oceanic divisions.
It spans an area of approximately 14,060,000 km2 and is the coldest of the world’s oceans.

places.name: Great Australian Bight

places.name: Gulf of Bothnia

places.name: Baffin Bay
facts: Baffin Bay, located between Baffin Island and the west coast of Greenland, is defined by the International Hydrographic Organization as a marginal sea of the Arctic Ocean.

places.name: Gulf of Carpentaria
facts: The Gulf of Carpentaria is a sea off the northern coast of Australia.
It is enclosed on three sides by northern Australia and bounded on the north by the eastern Arafura Sea, which separates Australia and New Guinea.

places.name: Gulf of Tonkin
facts: The Gulf of Tonkin is a gulf at the northwestern portion of the South China Sea, located off the coasts of Tonkin and South China.

reasons: Asked 2× in UP Lower Sub. Prelims, UPPCS Mains (2003, 2009)

places.name: Gulf of Suez
facts: The Gulf of Suez is a gulf at the northern end of the Red Sea, to the west of the Sinai Peninsula.
Situated to the east of the Sinai Peninsula is the smaller Gulf of Aqaba.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: Gulf of Aqaba
facts: The Gulf of Aqaba or Gulf of Eilat is a large gulf at the northern tip of the Red Sea, southeast of the Sinai Peninsula, and west of the Arabian Peninsula.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: Davis Strait
facts: Davis Strait is a southern arm of the Arctic Ocean that lies north of the Labrador Sea.
It lies between mid-western Greenland and Baffin Island in Nunavut, Canada.

places.name: Straits of Florida
facts: The Straits of Florida, Florida Straits, or Florida Strait is a strait located south-southeast of the North American mainland, generally accepted to be between the Gulf of Mexico and the Atlantic Ocean, and between the Florida Keys and Cuba.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: Torres Strait
facts: The Torres Strait, also known as Zenadh Kes, is a strait between Australia and the Melanesian island of New Guinea.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

facts: The Puerto Rico Trench is located on the boundary between the North Atlantic Ocean and Caribbean Sea, parallel to and north of Puerto Rico, where the oceanic trench reaches the deepest points in the Atlantic Ocean.

places.name: Karakum Desert
facts: The Karakum Desert, also spelt Qaraqum and Garagum, is the 12th largest desert in the world, located in Central Asia.

places.name: Sonoran Desert
facts: The Sonoran Desert is a hot desert and ecoregion in North America that covers parts of the northwestern Mexican states of Sonora, Baja California, and Baja California Sur, as well as part of the Southwestern United States.

reasons: Asked 2× in UPPCS Mains, UPPCS Prelims (2016, 2018)

places.name: Gibson Desert
facts: The Gibson Desert is a large desert in Western Australia, mainly in an almost pristine state.
It is about 155,000 square kilometres in size, making it the fifth largest desert in Australia, after the Great Victoria, Great Sandy, Tanami and Simpson deserts.

reasons: Asked 2× in UPPCS Mains, UPPCS Prelims (2016, 2018)

places.name: Great Sandy Desert
facts: The Great Sandy Desert is an interim Australian bioregion, located in the northeast of Western Australia straddling the Pilbara and southern Kimberley regions and extending east into the Northern Territory.

places.name: Chihuahuan Desert
facts: The Chihuahuan Desert is a desert ecoregion designation covering parts of northern Mexico and the southwestern United States.

places.name: Dasht-e Lut
facts: Lut Desert is a desert with both extensive salt flats and dunes located in the provinces of Kerman and Sistan-Baluchestan, Iran.

places.name: Great Artesian Basin
facts: The Great Artesian Basin of Australia is the largest and deepest artesian basin in the world, extending over 1,700,000 square kilometres.

reasons: Asked 2× in UP Lower Sub. Prelims (2002, 2003)

places.name: Great Basin
facts: The Great Basin is the largest area of contiguous endorheic watersheds, those with no outlets to the ocean, in North America.

places.name: Iberian Peninsula
facts: The Iberian Peninsula, also known as Iberia, is a peninsula in southwestern Europe.

places.name: Guiana Highlands
facts: The Guiana Shield is one of the three cratons of the South American plate.
It is a 1.7 billion-year-old Precambrian geological formation in northeast South America that forms a portion of the northern coast.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: Patagonia
facts: Patagonia is a geographical region that encompasses the southern end of South America, governed by Argentina and Chile.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: Okavango Delta
facts: The Okavango Delta or Okavango Grassland is a vast inland delta in Botswana formed where the Okavango River reaches a tectonic trough at an elevation of 930–1,000 m in the central part of the endorheic basin of the Kalahari Desert.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: Columbia Plateau
facts: The Columbia Plateau is an important geologic and geographic region that lies across parts of the U.S. states of Washington, Oregon, and Idaho.

places.name: Kantō Plain
facts: The Kantō Plain, in the Kantō region of central Honshu, is the largest plain in Japan.
Its 17,000 km2 covers more than half of the region extending over Tokyo, Saitama Prefecture, Kanagawa Prefecture, Chiba Prefecture, Gunma Prefecture, Tochigi Prefecture, and Ibaraki Prefecture.

places.name: Nōbi Plain
facts: The Nōbi Plain is a large plain in Japan that stretches from the Mino area of southwest Gifu Prefecture to the Owari area of northwest Aichi Prefecture and extreme northern Mie Prefecture, covering an area of approximately 1,800 square kilometres.

places.name: Kra Isthmus
facts: The Kra Isthmus, also called the Isthmus of Kra in Thailand, is the narrowest part of the Malay Peninsula.
The western part of the isthmus belongs to Ranong province and the eastern part to Chumphon province, both in Southern Thailand.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: Apennines
facts: The Apennines or Apennine Mountains are a mountain range consisting of parallel smaller chains extending c. 1,200 km the length of peninsular Italy.

places.name: Black Forest
facts: The Black Forest is a large forested mountain range in the state of Baden-Württemberg in southwest Germany, bounded by the Rhine Valley to the west and south and close to the borders with France and Switzerland.

reasons: Asked 2× in UP Lower Sub. Prelims, UPPSC RI (2004, 2014)

places.name: Alborz
facts: Mountain range in northern Iran.

places.name: Altai Mountains
facts: The Altai Mountains are a mountain range in Central Asia, where Russia, China, Mongolia, and Kazakhstan converge, and where the rivers Irtysh and Ob have their headwaters.

places.name: Pontic Mountains
facts: The Pontic Mountains, Pontic Alps or Parhar Mountains form a mountain range stretching along the southern Pontic coast of the Black Sea in northern Anatolia, Turkey.

places.name: Balkan Mountains
facts: The Balkan mountain range is located in the eastern part of the Balkan Peninsula in Southeastern Europe.
It is conventionally taken to begin at the peak of Vrashka Chuka on the border between Bulgaria and Serbia.

places.name: Dinaric Alps
facts: The Dinaric Alps, also Dinarides, are a mountain range in Southern and South-Central Europe, separating the continental Balkan Peninsula from the Adriatic Sea.

places.name: Jura Mountains
facts: The Jura Mountains are a sub-alpine mountain range, a short distance north of the Western Alps, and mainly demarcate a long part of the French–Swiss border.

places.name: Vosges
facts: The Vosges are a range of medium mountains in Eastern France, near its border with Germany.
Together with the Palatine Forest to the north on the German side of the border, they form a single geomorphological unit and low mountain range of around 8,000 km2 in area.

places.name: Cantabrian Mountains
facts: The Cantabrian Mountains or Cantabrian Range are one of the main systems of mountain ranges in Spain.
They stretch for over 300 km across northern Spain, from the western limit of the Pyrenees to the Galician Massif in Galicia, along the coast of the Cantabrian Sea.

places.name: Allegheny Mountains
facts: The Allegheny Mountains are a mountain range situated in the eastern United States.

places.name: Mackenzie Mountains
facts: The Mackenzie Mountains are a Canadian mountain range forming part of the Yukon–Northwest Territories boundary between the Liard and Peel rivers.

places.name: Hoggar Mountains
facts: The Hoggar Mountains are a highland region in the central Sahara in southern Algeria, along the Tropic of Cancer, that covers an area of approximately 550,000 km2.

places.name: Southern Alps
facts: The Southern Alps is a mountain range extending along much of the length of New Zealand’s South Island, reaching its greatest elevations near the range’s western side.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: White Mountains
facts: The White Mountains are a mountain range covering about a quarter of the state of New Hampshire and a small portion of western Maine in the United States.

places.name: Toubkal
facts: Toubkal, also Jbel Toubkal or Jebel Toubkal, is a mountain in central Morocco, located in the Toubkal National Park.

places.name: Mount Stanley
facts: Mount Stanley, also known as Mount Ngaliema, is a mountain located in the Rwenzori range.
With an elevation of 5,109 m, it is the highest mountain of both the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, and the fourth-highest in Africa.

places.name: Titlis
facts: Titlis is a mountain of the Uri Alps, located on the border between the cantons of Obwalden and Bern.
At 3,238 metres above sea level, it is the highest summit of the range north of the Susten Pass, between the Bernese Oberland and Central Switzerland.

places.name: Mount Kinabalu
facts: Mount Kinabalu is the highest mountain in Malaysia and Maritime Southeast Asia, located on the island of Borneo in Sabah.

places.name: Mount Waialeale
facts: Mount Waiʻaleʻale is a shield volcano and the second highest point on the island of Kauaʻi in the Hawaiian Islands.

reasons: Asked 2× in UP UDA/LDA Prelims, UPPCS Prelims (1997, 2001)

places.name: Kīlauea
facts: Kīlauea is an active shield volcano in the Hawaiian Islands, located along the southeastern shore of Hawaii Island.

reasons: Asked 2× in UPPCS Mains, UPPCS Prelims (2006, 2009)

places.name: Mount Rainier
facts: Mount Rainier, also known as Tahoma, is a large, active stratovolcano in the Cascade Range of the Pacific Northwest in the United States.

reasons: Asked 2× in UPPCS Prelims, UPSC CSE Prelims (2001, 2021)

facts: Parícutin is a cinder cone volcano located in the Mexican state of Michoacán, near the city of Uruapan and about 322 kilometers west of Mexico City.

facts: Taal Volcano, also known as Taal Caldera, is a large caldera filled by Taal Lake in the Philippines.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: Mount Pinatubo
facts: Mount Pinatubo is an active stratovolcano in the Zambales Mountains in Luzon in the Philippines.
Located on the tripoint of Zambales, Tarlac and Pampanga provinces, most people were unaware of its eruptive history before the pre-eruption volcanic activity in early 1991.

places.name: Stromboli
facts: Stromboli is an island in the Tyrrhenian Sea, off the north coast of Sicily, containing Mount Stromboli, one of the four active volcanoes in Italy.

places.name: Mount Merapi
facts: Mount Merapi is an active stratovolcano located on the border between the province of Central Java and the Special Region of Yogyakarta, Indonesia.

places.name: Mount Apo
facts: Mount Apo is the highest mountain peak in the Philippines, with an elevation of 2,954 meters above sea level.
A large solfataric, dormant stratovolcano, it is part of the Apo-Talomo Mountain Range of Mindanao island.

places.name: Volcán de Colima
facts: The Volcán de Colima, 4,260 m, also known as Volcán de Fuego, is part of the Colima Volcanic Complex consisting of Volcán de Colima, Nevado de Colima and the eroded El Cántaro.

places.name: Sabancaya
facts: Sabancaya is an active stratovolcano in the Andes of southern Peru, about 70 kilometres northwest of Arequipa.

places.name: Tugela Falls
facts: Tugela Falls is a complex of seasonal waterfalls located in the Drakensberg of Royal Natal National Park in KwaZulu-Natal Province, Republic of South Africa.

reasons: Asked 2× in UPPCS Prelims, UPPSC RI (2014, 2015)

places.name: Kariba Dam
facts: The Kariba Dam is a double curvature concrete arch dam in the Kariba Gorge of the Zambezi river basin between Zambia and Zimbabwe.

places.name: Grand Coulee Dam
facts: The Grand Coulee Dam is a concrete gravity dam on the Columbia River in the U.S. state of Washington, built to produce hydroelectric power and provide irrigation water.

places.name: Nurek Dam
facts: The Nurek Dam is an earth-fill embankment dam on the Vakhsh River in Tajikistan.
Its primary purpose is hydroelectric power generation and its power station has an installed capacity of 3,015 MW.

places.name: Cahora Bassa Dam
facts: The Cahora Bassa lake—in the Portuguese colonial era known as Cabora Bassa, from Nyungwe Kahoura-Bassa, meaning "finish the job"—is Africa’s fourth-largest artificial lake, situated in the Tete Province in Mozambique.

places.name: Java
facts: Java is one of the Greater Sunda Islands in the South East Asian country of Indonesia.
It is bordered by the Indian Ocean to the south and the Java Sea to the north.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: Hokkaido
facts: Hokkaido is the second-largest and northernmost of Japan’s four main islands.
Together with its surrounding islands, it comprises the largest and northernmost prefecture, making up its own region.

reasons: Asked 3× in UP BEO Prelims, UP RO/ARO Prelims, UPPCS Prelims (1991, 2017, 2019)

places.name: Shikoku
facts: Shikoku is the smallest of the four main islands of Japan.
It is 225 kilometres long and between 50 and 150 kilometres wide.

reasons: Asked 3× in UP BEO Prelims, UP RO/ARO Prelims, UPPCS Prelims (1991, 2017, 2019)

places.name: Kyushu
facts: Kyushu is the third-largest and most southerly of Japan’s four main islands.
In the past, it has been known as Kyūkoku, Chinzei and Tsukushi-no-shima.

reasons: Asked 2× in UP BEO Prelims, UP RO/ARO Prelims (2017, 2019)

places.name: Sulawesi
facts: Sulawesi, also known as Celebes, is an island in Indonesia.
One of the four Greater Sunda Islands, and the world’s 11th-largest island, it is situated east of Borneo, west of the Maluku Islands, and south of Mindanao and the Sulu Archipelago.

reasons: Asked 2× in UP RO/ARO Prelims, UPPCS Prelims (2010, 2021)

places.name: Mindanao
facts: Mindanao is the second-largest island in the Philippines, after Luzon, and seventh-most populous island in the world.

reasons: Asked 2× in UP RO/ARO Prelims, UPSC CSE Prelims (2018, 2021)

places.name: Bali
facts: Bali is an Indonesian island and province and the westernmost of the Lesser Sunda Islands.
East of Java and west of Lombok, the province includes the island of Bali and a few smaller offshore islands, notably Nusa Penida, Nusa Lembongan, and Nusa Ceningan to the southeast.

reasons: Asked 2× in UP RO/ARO Mains, UPPCS Prelims (2017, 2021)

places.name: Lombok
facts: Lombok is an island in West Nusa Tenggara province, Indonesia.
It forms part of the chain of the Lesser Sunda Islands, with the Lombok Strait separating it from Bali to the west and the Alas Strait between it and Sumbawa to the east.

reasons: Asked 2× in UP RO/ARO Mains, UPPCS Prelims (2017, 2021)

places.name: Sumbawa
facts: Sumbawa is an Indonesian island, located in the middle of the Lesser Sunda Islands chain, with Lombok to the west, Flores to the east, and Sumba further to the southeast.

places.name: Timor
facts: Timor is an island at the southern end of Maritime Southeast Asia, in the north of the Timor Sea.
The name is a variant of timur, Malay for "east"; it is so called because it lies at the eastern end of the Lesser Sunda Islands.

places.name: Canary Islands
facts: The Canary Islands or Canaries are an archipelago in the Atlantic Ocean and the southernmost autonomous community of Spain, located about 100 kilometres off the northwest coast of Africa.

reasons: Asked 2× in UP Lower Sub. Prelims, UPPCS Prelims (2002, 2015)

places.name: Madeira
facts: Madeira, officially the Autonomous Region of Madeira, is an autonomous region of Portugal, in the Atlantic Ocean about 805 km southwest of mainland Portugal.

places.name: Azores
facts: The Azores, officially the Autonomous Region of the Azores, is an archipelago of Portugal, in the Atlantic Ocean, about 1,400 km west of the Portuguese mainland.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: Cuba
facts: Cuba, officially the Republic of Cuba, is an island country in the Caribbean.
It comprises the eponymous main island as well as 4,195 islands, islets, and cays.

reasons: Asked 2× in UP RO/ARO Prelims, UPPCS Prelims (2002, 2021)

places.name: Newfoundland
facts: Newfoundland is a large island within the Canadian province of Newfoundland and Labrador.
It is situated off the eastern coast of the North American mainland, to the south of Labrador.

reasons: Asked 2× in UPPCS Mains, UPPCS Prelims (1990, 2015)

places.name: Aleutian Islands
facts: The Aleutian Islands, also called the Aleut Islands, or Aleutic Islands, are a chain of 14 main, larger volcanic islands and 55 smaller ones.

reasons: Asked 2× in UPPCS Mains, UPSC CSE Prelims (1999, 2014)

places.name: Chagos Archipelago

places.name: Seychelles
facts: Seychelles, officially the Republic of Seychelles, is an archipelagic country consisting of 115 islands in the Indian Ocean.

places.name: Falkland Islands

reasons: Asked 2× in UPPCS Prelims, UPSC CSE Prelims (1993, 1994)

places.name: Sicily

places.name: Sardinia
facts: Sardinia, officially the Autonomous Region of Sardinia, is the second largest island in the Mediterranean Sea after Sicily, and one of the twenty regions of Italy.

places.name: Mallorca
facts: Mallorca, also spelled Majorca in English, is the largest of Spain’s Balearic Islands, and the seventh largest island in the Mediterranean Sea.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: Malta
facts: Malta is an island in Southern Europe.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: North Island
facts: The North Island is one of the two main islands of New Zealand, separated from the larger but less populous South Island by Cook Strait.

places.name: South Island
facts: The South Island is the larger of the two main islands of New Zealand by surface area, the other being the smaller but more populous North Island.

places.name: Faroe Islands
facts: The Faroe Islands, also known as the Faroes, are an archipelago in the North Atlantic Ocean and a rigsdel of the Kingdom of Denmark.

places.name: Bahamas

places.name: Puerto Rico
facts: Puerto Rico, officially the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, is a self-governing Caribbean archipelago and island organized as an unincorporated territory of the United States under the designation of commonwealth.

places.name: Cape Verde Islands

places.name: Bermuda Triangle

places.name: Crimea

places.name: Donbas
facts: The Donbas or Donbass is a historical, cultural, and economic region on the Russia–Ukraine border, lying predominantly in Ukraine.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: Tigray
facts: The Tigray Region is the northernmost regional state in Ethiopia.
The Tigray Region is the homeland of the Tigrayan, Irob and Kunama people.

places.name: Kachin State
facts: Kachin State is the northernmost state of Myanmar.
It is bordered by China to the north and east, Shan State to the south, and Sagaing Region and India to the west.

sources.title: ForumIAS PYQ Workbook: General Geography (2nd ed., 2026)

places.name: Amhara
facts: The Amhara Region, officially the Amhara National Regional State, is a regional state in northern Ethiopia and the homeland of the Amhara, Awi, Argobba, and Qemant people.

places.name: Oromia
